body: Both pieces are streaked from a clouded sample jar off treated rows. Sprayer residue has dried hard on them. I think they were put aside once the flies left the field edge.
title: Key ring and empty sprayer

body:
I was told to leave the kitchen open for one more shift, though the road count already included its address. I set aside a clean apron for the morning cook.

The second list, the one for people waiting inside, came back with no names. The man who carried it said the count was final and I was not to correct it.
title: Handwritten letter
